summary:
Requested a $75 ticket payment in the supplied ticketing sandbox, retried it after the initial confirmation timed out, and reviewed its payment activity.
The first payment attempt showed “Payment confirmation timed out.”
After retrying the payment, the ticket was confirmed.
Payment activity shows 1 captured charge and a total captured amount of $75.00; pending authorizations were not counted.
